messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual ($999, ships mid-November) isn't buyable yet — drop date unannounced; the Harlo B30 at $899, ~30 TH/s, is the one they can order today.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
Looked up for Sarah: The H15 Dual isn't on sale yet — 100 units loaded, drop date unannounced, ships mid-November. Steer to the Harlo B30, $899, ~30 TH/s, orderable now.
